title: Predicting Audience reactions for Morning Brew

brand.name: Morning Brew
brand.logo_note: Official Morning Brew wordmark from the Morning Brew Daily brand page, recoloured to a single colour with its own alpha mask.

tagline: Every day, Minds forecasts how Morning Brew readers will vote in the newsletter's Reader Poll, locked before voting closes, then scored against the published result.
note: Daily Reader Poll forecasts, each locked and timestamped before the result was known, scored against the result Morning Brew shows on the poll page. Separate from the public forecast ledger.
intro: Minds is a simulated audience built from published evidence about real people. Ask it the questions you would put to a reader panel, and get answers without recruiting one.

predicted.heading: How will readers vote in today's poll?
predicted.lead: Each morning Minds reads the new issue and forecasts the vote shares of its Reader Poll before the result is known. The forecast is locked with a timestamp; once Morning Brew shows the result, it is scored.

predicted.footnote: Forecasts from 150 Minds built on Morning Brew's published audience profile. A poll forecast after voting had opened is marked as late.

audience.name: Morning Brew Readers (US)
audience.question: Reader Poll: pick one answer.
audience.description: 150 Minds modelled on US readers of the Morning Brew daily newsletter, matched to Morning Brew's published audience profile.
audience.explainer: We built 150 Minds: simulated readers of Morning Brew. Each Mind is a complete person, with an age, a job, a news habit and a voice of their own, grounded in public sources. Together they match published statistics on who reads Morning Brew, so you can put a question in front of them the way you would a reader panel.

orbit.label: 150 Minds
